title: Cardiovascular Risk Data Preprocessing Lab
audience: Clinical learners cleaning simulated cardiovascular risk data before AI modeling.
objectives: Apply winsorization to cap extreme measurements.
Choose an imputation method for missing values.
Scale clinical features and inspect distribution changes.

sections.name: Feature Distributions
sections.purpose: Use boxplots to inspect remaining skew and outliers.

chatbot_guidance: Explain preprocessing as a patient-safety and model-quality step.
Clarify when mean versus median imputation matters.
Help learners interpret the remaining outlier metric.
